entries.title: Vectorized Dekker/TwoSum Variance + Depth-4 TQue DMA Overlap
entries.bottleneck: After 8caa859 shrank template 16MB workspace -> 1KB (33.61 pts), scalar Dekker/TwoSum variance (~88ns/elem, f32_c8192 29.16us) and depth-1 TQue serialization of 8 DataCopyPad streams dominated kernel duration.
mechanisms: Vectorized Dekker split (4097.0f * x) + TwoSum + factor.lo compensation into 39 element-wise Mul/Sub/Add/Muls ops with exact operand order (f32_c8192 29.16 -> 6.64us, 4.39x; sample 7.30 -> 5.47us, 1.34x)
Raised TQue depth 1 -> 4 (106KB < 192KB UB) to batch 4 input and 4 output DataCopyPad DMAs concurrently

Built on prerequisite 8caa859 (16MB -> 1024B non-zero workspace, removing template overhead) and extended by 544439e (55.10 -> 57.45): SetBlockDim = clamp(ceil(C/1024), 4, AIV) (~32KB/block + 4-block stability floor) + 32B DataCopy hitting 724GB/s HBM roof
entries.precision_guard: Bit-identical to scalar AccurateVariance across 240K-element replay and 48/48 extended cases. Mandatory PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() between dependent vector ops regardless of buffer aliasing (removing 39 barriers broke new_variance 1024/1024 at C=1024).
entries.transferable_rule: Vectorize Dekker/TwoSum compensated arithmetic preserving exact operand order and mandatory PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>(), overlap multi-stream DataCopyPad via depth-4 TQue, keep unused workspace at 1024B, and size SetBlockDim against the ~0.12us/block dispatch floor (~32KB/block, >=4-block stability floor).

entries.title: BF16 TransDataTo5HD Vertical SIMD Accumulate + Native FP16 + Single-TBuf Ping-Pong
entries.bottleneck: Reproducing numpy's non-associative sequential bf16 accumulation forced serial per-row loops (bf16_1024x1024 936.86-1969.5us), while per-row ReduceSum (~240 cyc) and 9 serial DMA/V syncs stalled tiles.
mechanisms: Transpose 16-32 rows in UB via hardware TransDataTo5HD<uint16_t> (zero workspace) so vertical SIMD Add executes exact sequential bf16 rounding in parallel (bf16_1024x1024 936.86 -> 103.54us, 9.05x)
Pack multiple rows into batched ReduceSumMultiN + resident==2 single-read wide-row path (cols <= 32K fp32 / 64K 16-bit)
Native 128-wide FP16 compute path (f16_4096x1024 96.68 -> 51.00us, beating torch 52.44us) + fused b1/b2 parameter broadcast
Single-TBuf arena with 256B bank-conflict skew and double-buffered MTE2/PIPE_V/MTE3 ping-pong (online public cases 11.7-23.6 -> 6.0-12.4us)
entries.precision_guard: Bit-identical to sequential numpy bf16 saturation (2080 == 2080 on (5, 4097)) + exact IEEE-754 RNE scalar RoundHalf & 64-bit Tuckerman SqrtRNE; 75/75 extended cases 3-run SHA-256 deterministic. Avoid 2-step WholeReduceSum (regressed 64c85cf 6-11% on 512/1024-col shapes) and never call SyncAll() in pure AIV kernels (ACL 507035).
entries.transferable_rule: When a golden reference requires non-associative sequential rounding along a reduction axis, transpose 16-32 independent rows via TransDataTo5HD and step vertically with SIMD vector instructions; keep horizontal vadd folding + single WholeReduceSum and gate statBlock=1 strictly to low-row shapes.

entries.title: Two-Half-Ring Async MTE3 + 64-Lane Window-Sliced Gather DP + Double-Buffered log_probs
entries.bottleneck: Every DP step computed the full padded state width [0, saf), rewrote Gather offset tables via Adds, stalled on synchronous VM3/M3V barriers to flush each log_alpha[t] row, and fell back to 16MB Slow() on wide C/S.
mechanisms: Slice Gather/Max/Exp/Ln/Select to the active 64-lane band [cStart, cEnd) and fuse boundary masks via And into a single Select per step
Per-slot 32B -inf guard + scalar Gather srcBaseOffset eliminate per-step Adds(offBC/offP) rewrites even when classes % 8 != 0

Two-half-ring (2*H slots) UB layout drains completed DP rows on MTE3 asynchronously while PIPE_V computes the opposite half-ring (t50 30.16 -> 15.16us, 5.91x vs CTCLossV3; t200 122.9 -> 57.3us, 2.14x)
Double-buffered multi-row log_probs MTE2 prefetch + zero-TQue two-TBuf UB envelope up to states<=2048 / classes~44K (eliminating 16MB Slow() cliff, 50-60x on wide C/S) + external TPipe
entries.precision_guard: Preserves hardware vmax(-inf, -inf) -> 0.0f pairwise order and in-chain PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() across all 8 int32/int64 index combinations; online public cases 11.6/8.3/8.3/10.1/10.1 -> 7.7/6.2/6.4/7.5/7.5us.
entries.transferable_rule: In sequential time-step DP kernels, buffer 2*H step outputs in UB so MTE3 bursts H rows asynchronously without blocking PIPE_V, pass row offsets via Gather srcBaseOffset, and slice vector width to the reachable state band.

entries.title: SCH_MODE_0 Zero-TQue Fast Kernel + FusedGroupPass In-UB Overwrite + Dynamic colTile/copyStep
entries.bottleneck: At d524473 (49.04), small/medium shapes paid TQue<2> bookkeeping and Copy+Update serialization (c128_r256 7.92us, sample 6.94us), high-batch KV-decode fragmented var into 512 tiny 128B stores (kv_decode_512 9.88us vs torch 7.44us), and fixed colTile=4096 starved cores on wide C.
mechanisms: Specialized SCH_MODE_0 zero-TQue KernelFast (116KB static UB): RunSingleCoreInUB issues var/scales/zp/updates in one MTE2 burst, overwrites updated slices in UB via 32B DataCopy, and writes var_out in one Store1D; RunFrontLoaded hides update MTE2 behind CopyPass

FusedGroupPass (in SCH_MODE_1 KernelStream) streams double-buffered 32KB whole-group var stages, overwrites updated rows directly in UB, and flushes contiguous 32KB bursts (kv_decode_512 9.88 -> 7.16us, 1.38x, beating torch)

Dynamic colTile ([512, 4096]) + dynamic copyStep (8/16/32KB) + front-loaded first update tile saturate AIV cores on wide-C and preserve double-buffering on ~1MB shapes (c128_r256 7.92 -> 5.26us 1.51x, c1024_r1024 7.18 -> 6.58us)
Builds on precursor d524473 (44.76 -> 49.04): depth-2 TQue ping-pong, gated multi-row O(log2) scale replication, 32B DataCopy fast path, and UB index cache
entries.precision_guard: Bit-exact int8 (0/64 sample, 116/116 isolated extended cases) + offline state-machine check (WALK_OK 2041 quant blocks + 279 copy/fused partitions). vvPtr != yyPtr guards in-place aliasing; compile-time disjoint event IDs (0..1 / 2..3 / 4) prevent TQue collisions; every Cast/DataCopy <-> arithmetic boundary keeps PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>().
entries.transferable_rule: Isolate small/single-batch shapes onto a dedicated zero-TQue SCH_MODE_0 kernel binary (in-UB overwrite + front-loaded DMA overlap), fuse small-group scatter-copies in UB to turn fragmented writes into 32KB contiguous bursts, and dynamically shrink colTile/copyStep whenever fixed tiles under-occupy AIV cores.

entries.title: NaN-Sentinel Cross-Core Deterministic Reduction + Lean Deduplicated PIPE_V Margin Loop
entries.bottleneck: Multi-core mean/sum reduction via float atomics (32B-granular SetAtomicAdd OOB into 4B y[0] -> TLE) or unguarded scratch buffers (fast worker publishing before core 0 sentinel -> RE) caused online zeroing, forcing 1-core fallback (43.96 pts).
mechanisms: Out-of-domain NaN sentinel (0x7FC00000) + explicit gate-word handshake with DataCacheCleanAndInvalid for zero-workspace cross-core synchronization

Fixed-order fp32 summation on core 0 + single sizeof(T) write to y[0] + deferred is_target prefix restore (32x1024 mean 3178 -> 108.36us 29.3x, 256x32 mean 705 -> 27.78us 25.4x, 64x64 mean 325 -> 17.98us 18.1x)
Deduplicated target histogram driving tight Adds -> Maxs -> Muls -> Add PIPE_V loop with one final Select + ReduceSum

Negative lesson (f8c1f9c vs 2d0af18): never compile Sort32/MrgSort into the small-C kernel or trigger at C<=128 (regressed small shapes 1.4-2.5x); isolate KernelSort in SCH_MODE_1 gated to C>=512 & C*min(C,L)>=131072.
entries.transferable_rule: Replace non-deterministic cross-core float atomics on scalar outputs with cache-coherent GM slots guarded by an out-of-domain sentinel (NaN 0x7FC00000) + DataCacheCleanAndInvalid, summed in fixed core order on block 0; isolate heavy Sort32 paths in a separate TILING_KEY.

entries.title: Canonical Dimension Collapsing + V3 Multi-Regime Separable H/W Vectorized Folding
entries.bottleneck: Enumerating R-dimensional folding preimages per row folded inner W margins repeatedly for every outer preimage combination and issued fragmented per-row DataCopyPad GM reads (bigpad_2d_8x8_p64 1523.79us, wide_1x1x2x8192 460.13us).
mechanisms: Canonical dimension collapsing drops unit dims and fuses adjacent zero-pad dims so 4D/5D NCHW/NCDHW tensors reduce to 1D/2D/3D with zero copy

Separable Kronecker folding accumulates outer and H margins in UB first so inner W Gather<float> folding runs only once per output row (bigpad_p64 1523.79 -> 12.12us 125.7x, fp16_4d 142.20 -> 16.71us 8.51x)

4 specialized execution regimes: Pure Copy MTE2<->MTE3 stream, Column-Chunked Wide Parallel (wide_1x1x2x8192 460.13 -> 5.82us 79.1x), Whole-2D-Plane single-DMA batch, and Row-Tiled separable accumulator
Byte-weighted SetBlockDim (~16 KB effective work per AIV core) balances small-shape dispatch vs 40-core saturation (online public cases 7.0-7.9 -> 5.75-6.55us)
entries.precision_guard: 340/340 extended cases green across reflect/symmetric/circular/edge/constant in fp32 & fp16, with Kahan fallback for negative paddings or outer multiplicity > 96.
entries.transferable_rule: For separable multi-axis stencil/fold operators, collapse unpadded axes first and reduce outer/row axes in UB before executing inner-axis Gather instructions.

entries.title: Multi-schMode Binary Isolation + 64B Cacheline Tiling + HBM-Saturation Core Ramp + UB Vector Gather
entries.bottleneck: 2dd9acd's UB Vector Gather cut 32-case sum_med 5.71x (1056.8 -> 185.2us) but regressed online (49.65 -> 46.29) due to monolithic binary bloat (scalar_ratio 0.74-0.93 on pure DMA), 1704B tiling struct, 4-core small-shape floor, and 40-core over-dispatch past soc-a HBM saturation.
mechanisms: Isolated pure-DMA specialists (SCH_MODE_0) from UB Vector Gather specialists (SCH_MODE_1, GatherWord<u32|u16> + GatherByte 1B packing) via static __attribute__((noinline)) + if constexpr(sizeof(DTYPE_X)) pruning
Dropped coreStart[40][2] (1704B -> 1064B) and called rawTiling->SetDataSize(actualBytes) to shrink host->device tiling transfer to 64B (1 cacheline) when count<=3 or sameWidth
Added CONCATD_COPY_FLAT1 single-shot 32KB UB coalescing & 1-input outer collapse, plus LoadMetaToUb gating (count>=8/16)

entries.transferable_rule: Isolate heavy vector/gather specialists into a separate schMode tilingKey using static __attribute__((noinline)) functions so pure-DMA paths stay lean, trim tiling payloads to 64B via rawTiling->SetDataSize(), and cap DMA blockDim at the SoC HBM saturation knee (~22 AIV cores on soc-a at 2-4MB) with 1 core below 16KB.

entries.title: 6-schMode Static 48-Bank UB Arena + Bimodal Subcore Warmth + Deduplicated BUILD_GROW GM Reads
entries.bottleneck: Scalar/control pipe (aiv_scalar_ratio 0.348 fp32 / 0.437 fp16) dominated TQue/branch overhead, unaligned small-inner shapes hit scalar GM+PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> cliffs (53us), and 40-core dispatch amplified redundant BUILD_GROW scalar GM reads (2d_4200_3 12.61 -> 29.23us).
mechanisms: 6 compile-time schMode TILING_KEY kernels (SCALAR/LARGE_INNER/PAT_ONCE/WINDOW/GATHER/MASKED_TILE) shrinking per-mode I-cache ~5x

Host-precomputed 48-bank conflict-free static UB arena (<184KB) coloring 8 ping-pong buffers at distinct mod-1536B residues with manual (EVENT_ID0, EVENT_ID1) ping-pong & Level-0 whole-repeat Mul/Muls
Bimodal subcore I-cache warmth dispatch (<=16KB -> 1 block, >16KB -> 40 blocks 512B-aligned): 4d_64_1024_3_3 53.02 -> 9.82us (5.40x), 1M fp32 12.58 -> 8.96us (1.87 TB/s)
Deduplicated BUILD_GROW GM reads (7efadf8, 57.81 -> 62.44): load unique wc weights from GM once into UB then replicate locally (8x-16x less scalar GM traffic; 2d_4200_3 29.23 -> 12.90us, 2.27x)
entries.precision_guard: 93/93 isolated extended cases green (fp32/fp16/bf16). Static UB arenas MUST reserve >=10KB below ubSize (dav_c220 TMP_UB_OFFSET = ubSize - 8KB used internally by Select); zero-init wBuf before Gather; fp16 vector counts must round up to 128 elements.
entries.transferable_rule: Specialize broadcast regimes into compile-time TILING_KEY kernels over a host-colored 48-bank static UB arena strictly below ubSize - 10KB (TMP_UB_OFFSET), use bimodal 1-or-all-AIV dispatch for I-cache warmth, and deduplicate per-core prologue scalar GM reads into UB before replicating.

entries.title: Canonical Dim Collapsing + 4x32KB Flat Ring + SkipStepRows Multi-Row Gather + Element-Count Core Sizing
entries.bottleneck: Serialized 1D MTE2/MTE3 loops capped huge slices at ~11GB/s/core (full_r2_huge 81-104us), row-by-row odometer walks spent 21.8us on aiv_scalar (r3_mid_slice 38.7us), and traffic-byte core sizing starved scatter-heavy r5_mixed at 4 cores (40.0us).
mechanisms: Device-side CollapseDims merges full unit-stride trailing dims right-to-left (collapsing whole/outer slices to 1D and (64,128,256) to 2D) over a single static 182.5KB 512B-aligned TBuf pool
Engine 1 streams 1D unit-stride slices through a 512B-aligned 4x32KB MTE2<->MTE3 hardware ring (full_r2_huge 81.0 -> 28.6us min / 103.8 -> 29.6us med, 3.5x)

Engine 2.1 skips maximal zero spans via O(m) SkipStepRows into 16KB ZeroSpans (r3_mid_slice aiv_scalar 21.8 -> 3.27us, total 38.7 -> 16.7us) and batches forward/reversed rows via 4-event double-buffered O(log2) Gather
Element-count blockDim sizing above 4KB (clamp(ceil(total/256), 2, maxCores)) + 1-core whole-tensor UB burst <=4KB cut 13-level min sum 221.5 -> 134.4us (1.65x; r5_mixed 40.0 -> 13.0us, 3.07x)
entries.precision_guard: 195/195 isolated per-process extended cases green (raw bit moves). Sentinel offset kSentElem=8224 (>= cap+32) prevents 32B-tail DataCopyPad corruption; explicit HardEvents for MTE3 reuse (never PipeBarrier<PIPE_MTE3>); da1ba4d pitched-store trap proved output buffers must be NaN-poisoned in harnesses and pitched stores over many rows regress MTE3.
entries.transferable_rule: Collapse full unit-stride trailing dims, skip outer zero spans in O(m) into bulk ZeroSpans, stream 1D slices via a 512B-aligned 4x32KB ring, batch multi-row scatters via O(log2) Gather (sentinel >= cap+32), and size blockDim by output element count (not traffic bytes) when scalar scatter/odometer work dominates.

entries.title: Canonical Axis Coalescing + Universal Double-Buffered Level-0 Gather Transpose (All 11 Dtypes incl. 1B)
entries.bottleneck: 1-byte dtypes had no vector path (i8_512x512 513.0us scalar), TransDataTo5HD imposed a ~6us fixed issue wall on medium squares (f32_1024x1024 28.5us, f32_128x128 6.94us), and incomplete BuildPlan folding missed NCHW<->NHWC & cyclic 3D permutations.
mechanisms: Full canonical adjacent-axis coalescing without UB-chunk truncation collapses NCHW<->NHWC, cyclic 3D, and 4D block swaps into 2D/batched-2D transposes and splits >48KB spans across 40 cores

Universal double-buffered 2D in-UB Normal-mode Level-0 Gather<u32|u16> block transpose (zero SetMaskCount toggling, zero 6us TransDataTo5HD wall; f32_1024x1024 28.48 -> 15.26us, f32_128x128 6.94 -> 3.79us)
Odd/1-byte dtypes widened bit-exactly via Level-0 Cast<half, uint8_t> -> Gather<u16> -> Cast<uint8_t, half> (i8_512x512 513.01 -> 8.54us, 60.1x, beating torch 14.9us)

Single-descriptor 2D GM<->UB DMA + 4-event ping-pong + zero workspace + follow-up ea0d191/6606085 (48.83 -> 50.11) O(log2) 32B-chunk Level-0 Adds offset doubling (32-case sum_med 200.11us, 2.54x vs torch)
entries.precision_guard: Bit-exact across all 11 dtypes (160/160 extended, 556-1356 plan checks, 29,667 offset-doubling combinations). srcRowsAlloc guards partial tail Gather reads; hasGathered gates V_S before offset rebuild. Anti-pattern (52f8066, 48.83 -> 47.56): moving <=128B broadcast headers from scalar GetValue() to all-core MTE2 DataCopy caused +2.13us cacheline contention.
entries.transferable_rule: Coalesce all adjacent source-contiguous axes without UB-chunk truncation, replace fixed-latency TransDataTo5HD with single-descriptor 2D double-buffered Normal-mode Level-0 Gather<u32|u16> (widening 1B dtypes via Cast<half,u8>->Gather<u16>->Cast<u8,half>), build periodic offset tables via O(log2) Level-0 Adds, and keep <=128B broadcast headers on scalar GetValue().

entries.title: Hoisted Level-0 Intrinsics + 8-Row Gather Pack MTE3 Coalescing + Differential Slot Clear
entries.bottleneck: Level-2 vector APIs emitted ~65 redundant SPR mask ops/step, boundary masking cost 2x CompareScalar+And+Select (+2 PipeBarriers/step), full-row -inf Duplicate ran on every ring slot reuse (wide U=1201 198us), and odd-stride U forced H unaligned DataCopyPad writes.
mechanisms: Hoisted SetMaskNorm()+ResetMask() with Level-0 <T, false> intrinsics and contiguous [s0,s1,s2] scratch fusing 3x Exp into 1 call
2-cycle scalar boundary bitmask + SetVectorMask + Duplicate<float, false> replaced 2x CompareScalar+And+Select, cutting 2 PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>()s/step
Differential [dirtyLo, dirtyHi) per-slot clearing overlapped with Gather (t650_c64_s600 U=1201 198.14 -> 158.64us, 1.25x)
8-row Gather pack into contiguous 8*U floats (32B-aligned) turned 8 DataCopyPad writes into 1 aligned DataCopy burst + Cycle-0 async MTE2 prologue (t50 15.00us, 6.08x vs CTCLossV3)
entries.precision_guard: Critical 256B repeat-padding invariant: with hoisted SetMaskNorm()+ResetMask(), Level-0 <float, false> repeat=1 ALWAYS writes a full 64-float (256B) vector; padding lossBuf from 16 -> 64 floats fixed async MTE3 packBuf0 overwrite (bad 48/9100 -> 0/9100, 34/34 extended + 3-run DET green).
entries.transferable_rule: Hoist SetMaskNorm()+ResetMask() with Level-0 <T, false> intrinsics, fuse unary ops over contiguous scratch, pack 8 odd-stride rows via Gather into 1 aligned 32B MTE3 burst, and always pad every Level-0 destination buffer to a full 256B repeat when adjacent UB buffers are live on async MTE3.

Explicit PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() ordering narrowing Cast strictly behind widening + Add stages across loop iterations
